pre_commit_repair_disclosed.what: experiments/EXP-YIELD-002/specification.yaml did not parse as authored. At line 976 the mapping key `independence_note_for_the_tail_checks_and_for_CR_4` sat at indent 4, the same indent as the `- >-` items of the block sequence opened by `tail_checks:` at line 963. A mapping key cannot be a sibling of block-sequence entries.
pre_commit_repair_disclosed.repair: Lines 976 to 997 were dedented by exactly two spaces, making the key a sibling of `tail_checks` and `replication` under `experiment`, which is plainly where its name places it.
pre_commit_repair_disclosed.who: The dispatching Coordinator session, not the authoring subagent. The author has no shell and could not parse its own output.
pre_commit_repair_disclosed.verification: The change was proven WHITESPACE-ONLY by stripping all whitespace from the file before and after and asserting byte equality. The note's text is intact at 1443 characters. This is the fourth occurrence of this exact structural fault in this program.
pre_commit_repair_disclosed.why_not_sent_back: A two-space dedent with a byte-level whitespace-only proof is mechanical. It changes no content, no number, no claim and no threshold. It is disclosed here rather than left silent.
